about.title: Description
paragraphs: Flynn's Arcade develops original games and publishes titles by other creators. The company focuses on accessible, carefully designed games that give players an enjoyable experience.

about.title: Early History
paragraphs: The project began at the Autonomous University of Barcelona, where Juan Peralta taught and supervised video-game degree projects. With Felipe Lumbreras and student Xavier Alsina, the team explored an augmented-reality mobile game inspired by board games.
Developers and artists came together to create OUTSIDERS, a prototype combining tabletop strategy and video games with augmented reality. During that project, Juan met designer Francisco Raya.

about.title: After That
paragraphs: After completing the OUTSIDERS demo, team members moved on to different projects. Juan and Francisco continued developing new ideas, leading to Flynn's Arcade and further game projects.
